caption: The drawing depicts a single, upright glass bottle with a narrow neck and a slightly flared rim. The body of the bottle is elongated, oval, and vertically ribbed, tapering gently towards both the neck and the base. The color of the bottle is a translucent bluish-green, with darker tones used to depict shading, reflections, and the thickness of the glass, as well as subtle highlights and small bubbles inside the glass. The background is plain and off-white with minor brownish spots scattered throughout. There is no additional object in the image, and the lower right corner of the drawing contains handwritten text.
title: Toilet Bottle
